title: Pelican on a Bicycle
provenance: Independent WebGL sunset ocean/pier, bicycle frame/wheels/rotating spokes/crank/chain/basket, articulated pedaling pelican with separate feather geometry and moving camera shots. Original 3D mesh, textures, renderer and sky lighting are not recovered. No original video/image/full-frame sequence is loaded.
subtitle: 鹈鹕骑自行车
footer: EVERY FEATHER, SPOKE AND WAVE COMPUTED FROM PURE MATHEMATICS
editable: Title/subtitle/footer, speed, pedaling frequency, seed and marks in project.json; independent model and camera geometry in composition.js.
fidelity: Full source shot sequence is reconstructed with dedicated independent WebGL geometry. Refined model addresses broken feather patches, bill/pouch shape, pedaling anatomy and sunset shading. Original sculpted anatomy, camera, microtexture and cinematic rendering remain visibly different; fidelity still needs work.
